One point
scenes.say: [casual] So you add colour. Five bars, five colours. [dry] Still doesn't pop. [beat] [emphatic] Because pop means... I can't find the point. [confident] Now it pops.

scenes.say: [conversational] So give them one. The point in the title. One bar in colour. [pointed] Everything else grey.

scenes.loop: Next time they say *pop*, you'll know.
scenes.say: [upbeat] Pop means no point. Point in the title. One colour, the rest grey. [playful] Next time they say pop... you'll know.
